name: Sunao Cool Princess Sayaka to Nangoku Oukyuu Kozukuri ~Nuicha Yada... Aka-chan Dekiru made Shikyuu ni Dashite Hoshii~
original_name: 素直クールプリンセス・サヤカと南国王宮子作り～抜いちゃヤだ…赤ちゃん出来るまで子宮に出して欲しい～
source:
The main character is an ordinary student.
One day, he is kidnapped by someone and when he wakes up, he finds himself surrounded by 3 beautiful women in a luxury palace.
They turn out to be princesses in a small tropical country and ask for the childmaking to be regarded as the official couple.

[From [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE054396.html]English DLSite[/url]]
